disc-solid-x-axis.alt: Left: the region under y = √x from x = 0 to 4, shaded, with one thin vertical rectangle whose height is √x. Right: the solid made by revolving the region about the x-axis, a rounded horn drawn in 3D with the x-axis through its center. The rectangle sweeps out one thin disc, highlighted in blue, with radius r = √x. Below: V = the integral from 0 to 4 of π(√x)² dx = 8π.
